author: GamesNus
quote:
This is a perfect example how a remake should be done, gorgeous graphics outstanding music and of course tight gameplay.

The original is the best game of all time in my opinion and somehow this one surpass it, only minor complain I will say is that they should have released master quest to give us a challenge for those who already know the game, but other than that perfect score
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: GamesNus
quote:
I don't understand how the critics gave this a 10 out of 10 after all the bugs and glitches and boring storyline that this game has.  

The first hour or so all you're doing is chores to prepare the apartment for the girl who cheated on you. They made Jason super soft, like a Maid and nothing like previous Main characters.

The storyline is lame and the frame rate really makes the game looks horrible, is 2026 and they should have figured out a way to increase the frame rate.

Don't believe all the hype from the critic because I'm a long time GTA fan and I literally requested a refund after playing 8 hours of this crappy game

author: GamesNus
quote: (NO SPOILER) While I must say the Graphics are AMAZING, the combat is outdated and the story line, well its one of the worst in a video game that I ever played.  Its amazing how when users review this they are called bots among other things, but when Supposed "Expert Critics" all unite to give it a perfect core, everyone thinks its legit.  I played about 80% of the game and had to shut it off, that's how pissed off I was getting with the storyline and the rinse and repeat combat.  The Original game is on my top 10 fav of all time, was really looking forward to this, but they screwed it up big time.  I would rent it first, I regret spending $60 on this.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
